messages.label: scam
messages.text: Canada Revenue: After reassessment of your 2025 return you are owed $391.07. Accept your deposit before it expires tonight: [link]
messages.note: CRA does not send refunds or deposit links by text; link steals login and banking info.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hello, this is Mark with RBC card security. We flagged a $1,240 purchase at a Best Buy in Mississauga — was that you? No? Okay, we'll need to cancel and replace your cards. One of our agents will come by this afternoon to pick up the old ones, just seal them in an envelope. And please don't mention it at the branch, there may be an employee involved.
messages.note: Fake bank fraud call sending someone to collect cards and telling you not to tell branch staff.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller (crying): Grandpa, it's me... I messed up, I got pulled over and they found something in the car that wasn't mine. I'm at the station. They said if I get $4,000 for bail tonight I can go home. Please don't call Mom, she'll freak out. A man from the court is going to call you.
messages.note: Fake grandchild in custody asking for urgent secret bail money.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: hi!! sorry this is weird, I was trying to log into my insta on a new phone and I think I typed your number by accident 🙈 you should have just got a text with 6 numbers, could you send it to me? thank you sm
messages.note: Hard: friendly ask for a one-time code that was really generated to take over the recipient's account.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello, I am very interested in the dining table. I am away on a ship so cannot view, but I trust you. I have sent $950 to cover the table plus the pickup agent. Please e-Transfer back $300 to the agent when you get it and he will collect on Thursday. God bless.
messages.note: Hard-ish: polite buyer who can't view and overpays, asks for refund of the difference.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi, thanks for your interest in the 1 bedroom on Bloor. I'm currently in Calgary taking care of my mother so I can't do viewings, but my agent can courier the keys. I've had 14 inquiries so I'm going with whoever confirms first. Please e-Transfer $1,450 (first month) and I'll send the signed lease.
messages.note: Landlord can't show the unit, pressure from other applicants, deposit before viewing.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi, my name is Sarah, a hiring coordinator. We're looking for part-time online assistants to help merchants optimize product data. 1 hour/day, paid $180-$420 daily, training provided. Message me to learn more.
messages.note: Unsolicited remote task job; leads to depositing crypto to unlock earnings.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hey Kevin, are we still on for the golf Saturday? I booked the 9am tee time
messages.note: Hard: 'wrong number' opener used to start a friendship that ends in crypto investment coaching.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: This is the collections department at Hydro One. Your account shows an overdue balance of $612 and our crew is scheduled to cut your service within the hour. To stop the disconnection you can pay right now using a prepaid Visa or at a Bitcoin machine, and I'll stay on the line with you.
messages.note: Threat of same-day power cut with payment by prepaid card or Bitcoin.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: This is Officer Grant from Service Canada. We found a rental car registered with your SIN at the border with drugs and cash inside. Your SIN is suspended and police will come to your home today. To protect your assets you must withdraw your savings and deposit them into the secure government terminal I'll send you by WhatsApp. Do not hang up.
messages.note: Fake government official threatening arrest and directing cash into a Bitcoin ATM via QR code.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: We're closing our Canadian warehouse 😢 All Canada Goose parkas $89, final day! Ships free coast to coast. Tap to shop before they're gone [link]
messages.note: Social ad for a copycat store with impossibly cheap branded goods.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello Daniel, 14 Maple Cres. Your password is known to me. I put a program on your device months ago and filmed you through the webcam while you visited certain sites. Transfer $1,900 in BTC to the address below in 2 days and the files are deleted. Otherwise everyone in your contact list gets them.
messages.note: Sextortion email using leaked personal data and a fake recording to demand Bitcoin.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: TD: Your verification code is [number]. It expires in 10 minutes. We will never call or text you asking for this code. Do not share it with anyone.
messages.note: Genuine bank OTP that warns not to share; no link or request.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Canada Post: Your parcel [number] was delivered to your community mailbox. Your key is in compartment 2. Track in the Canada Post app.
messages.note: Real delivery notice, nothing to pay or confirm.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi Dad, can you e-Transfer me $120 for my textbook? The bookstore finally got the bio one in. I'll show you the receipt when I'm home for reading week. Love you
messages.note: Child from usual number, specific context, small amount, no secrecy.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: You have a new message from the Canada Revenue Agency. To view it, sign in to My Account through Canada.ca. For your security, this email does not contain any links.
messages.note: CRA-style notification with no link, tells you to sign in yourself.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: lol this is literally us trying to parallel park downtown [link]
messages.note: Friend sharing an article link from known contact, nothing asked.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Good morning families, due to the freezing rain warning, all buses for our school are cancelled today. The school remains open. Please make your own arrangements and let the office know if your child will be absent.
messages.note: Urgent school notice with nothing suspicious: no link, money or data.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Order confirmed! Thanks for shopping with us. Order #[number]: winter boots, size 9. Subtotal $129.99, HST $16.90, total $146.89. You'll get a shipping update once it's on its way.
messages.note: Ordinary order confirmation for a purchase made.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder from Lakeview Dental: Priya has a cleaning on Mon Nov 24 at 3:15 PM. Reply C to confirm or call the office to reschedule.
messages.note: Routine dental appointment reminder.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey it's Jess! Switched to Fido so I have a new number now. Save this one. Still on for trivia Thursday?
messages.note: Friend with a new number asking for nothing.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi! Is the stroller still available? Any stains or damage? I'm in the east end, could come see it tomorrow evening.
messages.note: Normal buyer question, wants to see the item in person.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: File [number] – Recovery Approved. Our records show you filed a fraud report last spring about an online trading platform. Working with partner agencies, our unit has traced $31,500 of your funds. To release them, a refundable legal processing deposit of $1,200 is required by Friday. Reply with a phone number and an agent will walk you through the steps. Fraud Recovery Division, Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre
messages.note: Fake anti-fraud centre offers to recover past losses for a fee.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller (in Mandarin): Hello, this is the Shanghai Public Security Bureau. A bank card opened with your passport has been linked to a fraud case. You must not tell anyone about this call, not your family and not your school, or you will be charged too. I will transfer you to the officer handling your file. Please go somewhere private and keep your phone on.
messages.note: Hard: fake Chinese police demand secrecy before the extortion starts.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Video ad: "I'm proud to say this new program lets every Canadian share in our country's energy wealth. Deposit as little as $350 and the platform does the rest." Registration closes soon, sign up here: [link]
messages.note: AI video of a politician promoting a crypto-style investment.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Thank you for calling Windows technical support. I can see the alert on your screen, your IP has been flagged for suspicious banking access. Please don't turn off the computer. I'll have you type the ID into the remote support box so one of our certified technicians can clean it for you.
messages.note: Hard: call after a fake pop-up, gets remote access to the computer.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: heyy you're cute 😊 I'm Emily, 16, just moved to Burlington. saw you in the hockey pics on Ava's page. wanna switch to snap? I'm way more fun on there 😉
messages.note: Hard: fake teen profile opening a chat that leads to sextortion.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: CRA: Your GST/HST credit payment of $243.50 could not be deposited. Update your direct deposit information within 24h to receive it: [link]
messages.note: Fake CRA text with a link to 'update' banking details.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Good evening, this is Constable Brown with the financial crimes unit. Your bank's fraud department asked us to contact you. Your card was used by a suspect we arrested today and we need it as evidence. Please put it in an envelope with a note of your PIN, and a plain-clothes officer will pick it up within the hour.
messages.note: Hard: fake officer wants the card and PIN picked up by courier.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi Grandma it's me, please don't tell Mom. I was in a car accident and I'm at the police station. My lawyer says I need $4,500 for bail today or I stay here over the weekend. He's going to call you in 5 minutes to explain, please answer 😢
messages.note: Emergency 'grandchild' message asking for secret bail money.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi this is Ashley from Marketplace about the couch! Before I come over can you just verify you're a real person? Google is going to text you a code, just send it back to me 🙂
messages.note: Hard: 'buyer' asks for a verification code to take over an account.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi, I'll take the snowblower at your price of $400. My mover will pick it up. I've sent an Interac e-Transfer for $900 to cover his fee too, please send him the extra $500 once it clears. Check your email for the confirmation from Interac.
messages.note: Buyer 'overpays' with a fake transfer and asks for the difference back.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Basement suite available Dec 1 in Kitchener, $1,150 all inclusive, furnished. I'm overseas for work so I can't show it, but I'll mail the keys once you send first month and deposit by e-Transfer. Lots of messages so first come first served.
messages.note: Cheap rental, landlord can't show it, wants a deposit first.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi! Your profile matched our part-time role rating hotels online, 30 tasks a day, $200–$500 per day. Today you can try the training account for free. Once you reach level 2 you top up in USDT to unlock premium orders with higher commission.
messages.note: Task job that leads to paying crypto to unlock 'orders'.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Good morning David ☕ my uncle sent me his weekly trading notes again, I made 18% this week on the platform he uses. I don't usually share this with people but I feel I can trust you. Do you have any money sitting in a savings account doing nothing?
messages.note: Hard: online friend steering towards a fake crypto platform.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Enbridge Gas: FINAL NOTICE. Your account is past due $187.30. Service will be disconnected today at 4 PM. Avoid shutoff by paying now: [link]
messages.note: Same-day shutoff threat with a payment link.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Automated voice: This message is from the Canada Border Services Agency. A package in your name containing illegal items has been seized. A warrant will be issued for your arrest. Press 1 now to speak with an officer.
messages.note: Robocall threatening arrest; leads to payment demands.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Black Friday Clearance – outlet prices on Lululemon, up to 85% off, today only. Free shipping anywhere in Canada. Shop before stock runs out: [link]
messages.note: Fake store with impossible discounts.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: RBC: We declined a purchase of $612.40 at an online store on your Visa ending [number]. If this wasn't you, call the number on the back of your card. If it was you, you can approve it in the RBC Mobile app.
messages.note: Real fraud alert: no link, points to the number on the card.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Purolator: Your package will be delivered today by 9 PM. A signature is required. If no one is home, we'll leave a notice with the pickup location.
messages.note: Real courier notice with no fee.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey it's Mom. Can you e-Transfer me $85 for your half of Grandpa's birthday cake and flowers? Same email as always. Thanks hun, see you Sunday
messages.note: From Mom's usual number with clear context.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: GIVEAWAY ❄️ We're giving away 3 pairs of our wool socks to celebrate 10k followers! To enter, follow us and comment your favourite colour. Winners announced here Friday and can pick up at the shop. No purchase or payment ever needed.
messages.note: Shop's real giveaway with no payment or data.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder: your winter term tuition balance is due January 5. Log in to the student portal to view your account and payment options. A late fee applies to balances not paid by the deadline. Office of the Registrar
messages.note: School payment deadline that says to log in yourself.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Wealthsimple: [number] is your login code. Never share it with anyone. Our team will never ask you for this code.
messages.note: Genuine one-time code with a don't-share warning.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi Priya, confirming rent stays at $1,850 for the new lease starting Jan 1 like we discussed. Keep e-Transferring to the same address. I'll drop off the signed copy this weekend. Mike
messages.note: Landlord confirming the agreed rent, no new payment details.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: hey! it's Matt, finally upgraded my phone and got a new number. Old one's dead. Nothing urgent, just save this one 👍
messages.note: Friend's new number that asks for nothing.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi, interested in the winter tires. What size are they and how much tread is left? Could I come by Saturday to take a look? I'd pay cash.
messages.note: Normal buyer questions and in-person viewing.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your Ontario driver's licence expires in 60 days. You can renew online through ServiceOntario or at a ServiceOntario centre. We will never text you a payment link.
messages.note: Government reminder telling you to go to the official site yourself.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi team, the office is closed today because of the snowstorm. Please work from home if you can and let your manager know if you can't. Payroll is not affected. Thanks, HR
messages.note: Urgent employer notice with no ask.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hydro Ottawa: A planned power outage is scheduled on your street Thursday from 9 AM to 1 PM for equipment upgrades. No action is required.
messages.note: Real utility notice with no payment or link.
